source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with layered green-brown hills, dense tree groves, willows, thatched village buildings, winding paths and streams, a small bridge, and a lone scholar figure. Calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: distant_rolling_hills_path
motifs.description: Soft middle-left rolling hills with a pale winding path or stream threading through green-brown slopes and small blue-green shrub accents; isolate the landscape forms only, excluding nearby calligraphy and red seals.
must_preserve: thin contour lines defining rounded hill shoulders
muted green and ochre wash gradients
pale serpentine path or watercourse edge

motifs.name: upper_right_mixed_grove
motifs.description: Dense upper-right grove of interlaced trees including black-ink pine or bamboo-like needles, pale green leafy crowns, blue-green shrubs, and exposed trunks on a sloping bank; exclude all red seal impressions at the edges.
must_preserve: brown trunk linework and forked branches

motifs.name: central_willow_curtain
motifs.description: Tall central cluster of willows with dark trunks and long hanging curtains of fine leaves, set over muted hills and misty ground; isolate from adjacent upper grove and lower houses.
must_preserve: dark twisting trunks and bare side branches
soft green-gray wash behind the foliage
delicate gaps where mist shows through

motifs.name: mid_right_blue_green_bluff
motifs.description: Middle-right layered blue-green bluff and hillside terraces with winding footpaths, ochre banks, small shrubs, and rock-like mound textures below the upper grove.
must_preserve: blue-green mineral wash on bluff tops
fine terrace lines receding into the slope

motifs.name: lower_left_thatched_village
motifs.description: Lower-left village group of thatched-roof buildings, fence segments, garden shrubs, bamboo-like thickets, and leafless trees around the dwellings; exclude adjacent calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: dark dry-brush thatch texture on roofs
straight wall posts and roof geometry
low fence rails and gate lines
dense ink shrub and bamboo strokes

motifs.name: foreground_twisted_tree_rocks
motifs.description: Large foreground leafless twisting tree spreading horizontally across the lower center, with exposed roots, small blue rocks, ochre stones, and sparse grasses along a pale bank.
must_preserve: sinuous dark trunk and root linework
fine twig network at branch tips

motifs.name: right_meandering_stream_bridge
motifs.description: Right-side meandering stream or inlet with pale water ribbons, curved banks, a small arched footbridge or plank bridge, and dark grasses along the bank; isolate from the scholar figure and seal areas.
must_preserve: small bridge geometry with rail or plank marks

motifs.name: lower_right_scholar_mist_bank
motifs.description: Lone scholar figure on the lower-right path beside a broad pale mist or water opening, with nearby sloping bank and sparse vegetation; keep the figure and immediate setting only.
must_preserve: tiny robed scholar silhouette and hat
small stippled vegetation at the mist edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
